## About
Dr. Stephanie grew up in rural Minnesota and earned her Doctorate of Chiropractic from Parker University in Dallas. It was there that she became interested in working with pregnant women and children, and that interest led to additional training with the International Chiropractic Pediatric Association.
Her hope, and the hope of Mother Me Chiropractic as a whole, is to give you a comfortable, safe place to be heard, to feel nurtured, and to get exceptional care. She is known for being thorough in her communication and evaluation, and for gentle adjustments. She works with you to find the technique that fits your comfort and your body.
As she puts it: "Your body wants to express health and healing. My role is to help facilitate your body to feel and function its best."

## Services
- Prenatal: Dr. Stephanie is Webster Technique Certified for prenatal care through the International Chiropractic Pediatric Association.
- Babies: Gentle care for newborns. A parent wrote that Dr. Stephanie's gentle cranial work made a real difference for her C-section babies.
- Family: Adjustments for the whole crew, to help your family be its healthiest at any life stage.
- Neuro Spinal Correction: Neuro-Spinal Chiropractic care for spinal tension and the secondary conditions that can come from the spine and the nerves stemming from it.
- Craniosacral Therapy: Dr. Stephanie has completed training in Dynamic Body Balancing - Craniosacral Therapy.
- Dry Needling and Cupping: Dr. Stephanie is trained in providing dry needling and cupping.

## FAQ
Q: How young can my little one be for a first visit?
A: Our care for little ones starts from 1 hour old and goes to 1 year old.

Q: Do I need to be pregnant or have kids to come in?
A: No. Our care is for the whole family at any life stage, and one longtime patient wrote that she has been coming for years without kids.

Q: Is there parking?
A: Yes. There is plenty of parking in front of the building.
